cues.en: In this video, I will introduce you to a distribution based evaluation method called mauve.
cues.zh: 這支介紹以分布為基礎的評估方法，叫 MAUVE。

cues.en: The simple way to think about mauve is that it's the k distance between a probability distribution of
cues.zh: 簡單來說，是比較 LLM 生成詞元

cues.en: tokens generated by an LLM, versus a probability distribution of tokens generated by humans.
cues.zh: 與人類文字詞元的機率分布之 KL 距離。

cues.en: Unfortunately, we need some additional considerations because the number of tokens is so large, the
cues.zh: 但還需要其他考量，因為可能

cues.en: possible number of tokens is so large, and the number of tokens that are actually generated in a given piece of text is relatively small.
cues.zh: 詞元數太大，而一段實際生成文本中的詞元相對少。

cues.en: For example, GPT two has 50,000 tokens, but usually we are thinking about model generation sizes of
cues.zh: 例如 GPT-2 有約五萬個詞元，但通常生成的

cues.en: dozens or hundreds of tokens.
cues.zh: 只有幾十到幾百個。

cues.en: So to get a high quality estimate of the token probability distribution.
cues.zh: 要高品質估計詞元機率分布，

cues.en: We want really large samples, perhaps on the order of millions of tokens.
cues.zh: 希望有很大樣本，也許幾百萬詞元。

cues.en: And that's just not feasible to do for any given model.
cues.zh: 對某個模型，這不太可行。

cues.en: And so the idea of mauve is to come up with some clever quantization schemes that allow for KL divergence
cues.zh: 所以 MAUVE 用巧妙的量化方案，讓 KL 散度

cues.en: to be used without needing an extremely large amount of data.
cues.zh: 不必依賴極大量資料也能使用。

cues.en: So mauve is developed by this group, and I think this paper was actually the follow up to the original paper that was published a few years earlier.
cues.zh: MAUVE 由這個團隊開發，我想這篇其實是幾年前原論文的後續。

cues.en: It is still fundamentally based on KL divergence.
cues.zh: 本質仍以 KL 散度為基礎。

cues.en: So this is the way to think about the mauve score.
cues.zh: 可以這樣理解分數。

cues.en: But as I mentioned, the number of possible tokens is just so high relative to the amount of data that
cues.zh: 但如前所述，可能詞元數相對於

cues.en: we have in practice to estimate probability distributions that the idea is then to discretize or partition
cues.zh: 實際可用於估計分布的資料量太多，所以要離散化、分割，

cues.en: or quantize these distributions.
cues.zh: 或量化這些分布。

cues.en: So instead of having 50,000 individual tokens, there might be several dozen quantized partitions.
cues.zh: 不再有五萬個個別詞元，而可能只有幾十個量化分區。

cues.en: That quantization is done based on joint statistical characteristics of the human and the model data.
cues.zh: 量化依人類與模型資料的聯合統計特徵進行。

cues.en: So that addresses one issue with the naive approach of KL divergence.
cues.zh: 這處理了直接用 KL 散度的一個問題。

cues.en: A second issue is that there is no upper bound on the KL distance.
cues.zh: 第二個問題，是 KL 距離沒有上界。

cues.en: So the KL distance measure can be arbitrarily large, and that will depend on the data characteristics and the sample size and the number of partitions.
cues.zh: 它能任意大，也取決於資料特性、樣本量與分區數。

cues.en: And that is problematic because it means that different models with different numbers of tokens, and
cues.zh: 這會有問題，因為不同詞元數的模型，

cues.en: also different numbers of quantized joint probability distributions can give different results.
cues.zh: 以及不同量化聯合分布的數量，都可能給不同結果，

cues.en: Even apart from the capabilities of the model itself.
cues.zh: 即使與模型能力本身無關。

cues.en: In other words, you could get apparent differences between models in KL divergence simply because of
cues.zh: 換句話說，模型間表面的 KL 差異，可能只因

cues.en: the tokenizer and quantization process, not because of the model capabilities.
cues.zh: 斷詞與量化流程，而非能力。

cues.en: So that leads to the second clever trick in mauve, which is to use something called a frontier analysis.
cues.zh: 這引出 MAUVE 第二個技巧，稱為 frontier analysis，前緣分析。

cues.en: This is basically a way of getting the KL distance to be bound between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 基本上，是讓 KL 距離受限於 0 到 1 的方式。

cues.en: Here, the idea is to mix the probability distributions of the human and the model text with varying amounts.
cues.zh: 概念是以不同比例，混合人類與模型文字的機率分布。

cues.en: So that's for this r lambda over here.
cues.zh: 就是這裡的 R_lambda。

cues.en: So for any given value of lambda you can add the scaled probability distribution of the model data and the human data.
cues.zh: 每個 lambda 值，都把縮放後的兩種分布相加。

cues.en: So let's take P to be the model data and Q to be the human data.
cues.zh: 假設 P 是模型，Q 是人類。

cues.en: Now when lambda is zero then R is 100% human data and 0% model data.
cues.zh: lambda=0 時，R 是百分之百人類、零模型。

cues.en: And when lambda is one, then R is 100% model data and 0% human data.
cues.zh: lambda=1 時，R 是百分之百模型、零人類。

cues.en: And when lambda is 0.5, then there is an exact average of the two data sources.
cues.zh: lambda=0.5 時，兩來源剛好平均。

cues.en: So now the idea is to vary lambda between 0 and 1.
cues.zh: 讓 lambda 在 0 到 1 之間變動，

cues.en: And that will carve out this curved line in this space over here.
cues.zh: 就會在這個空間畫出曲線。

cues.en: This is called a divergence curve.
cues.zh: 叫做散度曲線。

cues.en: And then you calculate the area under that curve which is all of this blue stuff indicated here.
cues.zh: 接著計算曲線下面積，也就是藍色部分。

cues.en: That area is bound by zero and one, and that is the mauve score.
cues.zh: 面積介於 0 與 1，就是 MAUVE 分數。

cues.en: Don't worry about this orange box here.
cues.zh: 不用管橘框，

cues.en: That's a different metric that they discuss in their paper.
cues.zh: 那是論文討論的另一個指標。

cues.en: But that is not the main score that we will be working with.
cues.zh: 不是這次主要分數。

cues.en: So I hope this explanation makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望這樣解釋能理解。

cues.en: It's a bit of high level, and there's a lot of mathematical details that are in the paper that expand on these ideas and prove that they are appropriate.
cues.zh: 有點高層次，論文有很多數學細節，進一步展開並證明這些想法。

cues.en: The take home point.
cues.zh: 重點是，

cues.en: The upshot is that the mauve score varies between 0 and 1, and a score closer to zero indicates that
cues.zh: MAUVE 在 0 到 1 之間，越接近零，表示

cues.en: the model output looks nothing like the human data, and a score closer to one indicates that the model
cues.zh: 模型輸出越不像人類資料；越接近 1，表示

cues.en: data would be indistinguishable from human data, because the probability distributions of the tokens are the same.
cues.zh: 兩者詞元機率分布相同，無法區分。

cues.en: Oh, there's one more thing I wanted to mention you saw in the previous video that whether you choose
cues.zh: 還有一件事。上一支看過，選

cues.en: P or Q to be the model data is important because that impacts the KL divergence score in mauve.
cues.zh: P 或 Q 當模型資料，會影響 KL 散度；但在 MAUVE，

cues.en: It doesn't actually matter because of the symmetry of how these two probability distributions are mixed.
cues.zh: 因混合方式對稱，就沒關係。

cues.en: The area under this curve under the divergence curve is the same, regardless of whether you take P or Q to be the model or the human data.
cues.zh: 無論 P、Q 哪個是模型、哪個是人類，散度曲線下面積相同。

cues.en: At least they are the same within reasonable tolerance levels.
cues.zh: 至少在合理容忍範圍內相同。

cues.en: The score might be very, very slightly different just from quantization and so on.
cues.zh: 量化等因素，可能造成極小差異。
